result.instructions: Tools for F-sąskaita, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our invoices are still unpaid, and how much is outstanding?"; "Create a VAT invoice for ACME UAB for 10 hours of consulting at 50 EUR per hour, due in 14 days."; "List the expenses from September and their totals by supplier.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes F-sąskaita data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run fsaskaita_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run fsaskaita_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run fsaskaita_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. fsaskaita_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: fsaskaita_get_profile
tools.title: Get business profile
tools.description: Get the business that the token belongs to: name, business type, address, VAT code and company code. A good first call. GET /profile.

tools.name: fsaskaita_list_currencies
tools.title: List currencies
tools.description: List the currency codes and titles that invoices and expenses accept. GET /currencies.

tools.name: fsaskaita_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List finalized invoices, newest first, 50 per page. Drafts made in the app are not included. The meta block gives current_page, last_page and total. GET /invoices.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Each page holds 50 items.

tools.name: fsaskaita_get_invoice
tools.title: Get an invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice with its seller, buyer, lines (products), payment options, totals and share_link. GET /invoices/{invoice}.

invoice_id.description: The UUID from a list or get tool.

tools.name: fsaskaita_download_invoice_pdf
tools.title: Download invoice PDF
tools.description: Download the PDF of one invoice. Returns the file as base64 with its content type and file name. Files over 3 MB are refused. GET /invoices/{invoice}/download.

invoice_id.description: The UUID from a list or get tool.

tools.name: fsaskaita_list_expenses
tools.title: List expenses
tools.description: List expenses, newest first, 50 per page. Each item has date, total, currency, seller and timestamps. GET /expenses.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Each page holds 50 items.

tools.name: fsaskaita_get_expense
tools.title: Get an expense
tools.description: Get one expense: date, total (with VAT), currency, seller and timestamps. The stored VAT and supplier invoice number are not returned. GET /expenses/{expense}.

expense_id.description: The UUID from a list or get tool.

tools.name: fsaskaita_download_expense_file
tools.title: Download expense file
tools.description: Download the document file (receipt or invoice) of one expense. Returns the file as base64 with its content type and file name. Files over 3 MB are refused. GET /expenses/{expense}/download.

expense_id.description: The UUID from a list or get tool.

tools.name: fsaskaita_create_invoice
tools.title: Create an invoice
tools.description: WRITE: create and finalize a new invoice in the business. It takes a number, queues its PDF and fires the invoice.created webhook. Omit invoice_number to take the next number of the series. The call is NOT repeatable: after a network error, list invoices before you retry. POST /invoices.

type.description: Invoice type. The *vat_invoice types need vat_percentage on every line.

series.description: Series code. A new code starts its own number counter.

notes.description: Free text printed under the lines.

invoice_number.description: Number within the series, unique there. Omit on create to auto-number.

currency.description: Currency code from fsaskaita_list_currencies, e.g. EUR.

language.description: Language of the PDF and share page. Defaults to lt.

type.description: company or individual. person is a legacy alias of individual.

company_name.description: Required for companies; not allowed for individuals.

company_code.description: Company registration code; not allowed for individuals.

first_name.description: Required for individuals; not allowed for companies.

last_name.description: Required for individuals; not allowed for companies.

individual_activity_id.description: Individual activity certificate number; not allowed for companies.

use_default_seller_info.description: true copies the seller block from the business profile. Then omit seller.

custom_fields.description: Extra label/value pairs printed in the seller block.

units.description: Unit of measure, e.g. h, pcs.

price.description: Unit price excluding VAT. Give exactly one of price, total, total_incl_vat.

total.description: Line total excluding VAT. Give exactly one of price, total, total_incl_vat.

total_incl_vat.description: Line total including VAT. Give exactly one of price, total, total_incl_vat.

vat_percentage.description: VAT rate 0-100. Required on every line for the *vat_invoice types.

payment_options.description: Payment details printed on the invoice.

type.description: bank takes the bank fields; other takes free-form fields.

bank_account.description: IBAN. Required for bank; not allowed for other.

bank_name.description: Required for bank; not allowed for other.

tools.name: fsaskaita_update_invoice
tools.title: Replace an invoice
tools.description: WRITE: replace EVERY field of an existing invoice with the values you send. Read the invoice first with fsaskaita_get_invoice and resend all of it. invoice_number is required: without it the invoice is renumbered. Lines, payment options and seller fields are rewritten and the PDF is regenerated. PUT /invoices/{invoice}.

series.description: Series code. A new code starts its own number counter.

notes.description: Free text printed under the lines.

invoice_number.description: The current number of the invoice, e.g. 007 or 7. Always resend it.

currency.description: Currency code from fsaskaita_list_currencies, e.g. EUR.

language.description: Language of the PDF and share page. Defaults to lt.

type.description: company or individual. person is a legacy alias of individual.

company_name.description: Required for companies; not allowed for individuals.

company_code.description: Company registration code; not allowed for individuals.

first_name.description: Required for individuals; not allowed for companies.

last_name.description: Required for individuals; not allowed for companies.

individual_activity_id.description: Individual activity certificate number; not allowed for companies.

units.description: Unit of measure, e.g. h, pcs.

tools.name: fsaskaita_create_expense
tools.title: Create an expense
tools.description: WRITE: record a new expense with its document file (receipt or invoice from a supplier). The file is required. The call fires the expense.created webhook and is NOT repeatable: list expenses before you retry after a network error. POST /expenses (multipart).

currency.description: Currency code from fsaskaita_list_currencies, e.g. EUR.

vat.description: VAT amount inside total. Stored but not returned.

invoice_number.description: Supplier's document number. Stored but not returned.

file_base64.description: The document as standard base64, up to about 3 MB of file bytes.

filename.description: File name with its extension. Allowed: jpeg, jpg, bmp, gif, pdf, png, tiff, xlsx, xls, doc, docx, odf.

tools.name: fsaskaita_update_expense
tools.title: Replace an expense
tools.description: WRITE: replace EVERY field of an existing expense. Read it first with fsaskaita_get_expense and resend all of it. Stored VAT and supplier invoice number are not returned, so send them again if you need them. The file is optional: when you send one it replaces the stored file. PUT /expenses/{expense} (multipart).

expense_id.description: The UUID from a list or get tool.

currency.description: Currency code from fsaskaita_list_currencies, e.g. EUR.

vat.description: VAT amount inside total. Stored but not returned.

invoice_number.description: Supplier's document number. Stored but not returned.

file_base64.description: The document as standard base64, up to about 3 MB of file bytes.

filename.description: File name with extension. Needed with file_base64.
